title: YOUHAN ONE SDD manifest
description: Machine-readable process metadata for one specification directory. Authority for intended behaviour remains spec.md; this file must never contain requirements or acceptance criteria. See docs/sdd/MACHINE_CONTRACT.md.

schemaVersion.description: Supported manifest schema version. An unsupported value is SDD-V005.

specId.description: Must match the specification directory name. SDD-V002.

slug.description: Must match the directory suffix after the SPEC-NNNN- prefix.

kind.description: Which workflow governs: CHANGE_WORKFLOW, BUG_WORKFLOW or EMERGENCY_CHANGE_WORKFLOW.

risk.description: Risk level per docs/RISK_CLASSIFICATION.md. Must match spec.md. SDD-V006, SDD-V012.

status.description: Lifecycle state per docs/sdd/SPEC_LIFECYCLE.md. Must match spec.md and the last statusHistory entry. SDD-V007, SDD-V013, SDD-V019.

artifacts.description: Paths relative to the specification directory, or null where the artefact does not apply at this risk level. A path resolving outside the directory is rejected. SDD-V008.

statusHistory.description: Ordered lifecycle history. Only legal transitions are permitted, and the last entry must equal status. SDD-V018, SDD-V019.

approvals.description: Gate decisions. A gate requiring a human is satisfied only by actorType human. SDD-V020, SDD-V021, SDD-V022, SDD-V034.

reviews.description: Engineering review records. A review never satisfies an approval gate.

evidenceConflicts.description: EVC identifiers this specification cites. A specification may cite a conflict but may never close one. SDD-V035, SDD-V036.
